verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents multiple official SDKs/APIs for developers—Snowpark API for Python, Java, and Scala, the Snowflake SQL API, and REST APIs for resource management with OpenAPI specifications hosted in an official GitHub repo—plus a managed MCP server letting AI agents interact with Snowflake without custom infrastructure, directly supporting AI-native build patterns. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality/ergonomics and more explicit agent-framework integration examples beyond MCP.
